title: Reviewing Qualifying Criteria So That Silver Support Scheme Benefits More Needy Seniors
what_it_is: Reviewing Qualifying Criteria So That Silver Support Scheme Benefits More Needy Seniors

sections.label: Silver Support Scheme eligibility and enhancements
sections.summary: Eligibility uses lifetime wages, housing type and household support; enhancements raised payouts 20%, expanded thresholds, added a tier, and increased recipients and total payouts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Lifetime wages, housing type and the level of household support are used to decide who is eligible.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: MOM reviews the Silver Support Scheme regularly and enhanced the scheme last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: First, we have raised payouts for recipients by 20%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Second, we have expanded the thresholds for lifetime wages and household monthly income per person to cover more seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We have also added a new payout tier that provides a payout to seniors with household monthly incomes per person above $1,300 but not exceeding $1,800.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: With the enhancements, the number of Silver Support recipients has increased from one in five seniors in 2020, or about 150,000 seniors, to one in three seniors this year, or about a quarter of a million or 250,000 seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Total Silver Support payouts have also nearly doubled from $330 million in 2020 to $600 million per year today.

sections.label: Stepdown Silver Support payments
sections.summary: Seniors no longer eligible for Silver Support receive two tranches over two quarters of stepdown payments to ease their transition out of the scheme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: To the Member's suggestion about stepping down, seniors who are no longer eligible for Silver Support will receive two tranches over two quarters of a stepdown Silver Support payment to help ease their transition out of the scheme.
